messages.subject: Re: plotting sorted values in a ggplot
parts:
Abhi,

I don't see how this can be done with facets--you want each faceted
group to be sorted differently, implying a different order of axis
labels, but by definition vertically-stacked facets must share a
common x axis. I would either (1) re-think how to display these data,
or (2) bite the bullet and implement it using grid viewports.Try for
#1 first!

Regards,
Ben
